chapter.verse: Zingsang ciangin siampi liante leh Jew makaite khempeuh in Jesu thah theih nading thu vaihawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu hencipin paikhiatpih uh a, gam-uk mangpa Pilate' kiangah ap uh hi.
Jesu a lehhekpa Judas in Jesu sih thukhenna kibawl cih a muh ciangin lungnuamlo kikin siampi liante leh Jew makaite' kiangah ngun sumtang sawmthum paipihkik a,
“Mawhneilopa' sisan lehhekna tawh ka khial khin hi,” ci hi. Amaute in, “Ko tawh bang kisai ahi hiam? Hih pen nangma' vai hi lel hi,” cihsan uh hi.
Tua ciangin Judas in ngun sumtangte biakinnpi sungah paaisukin paikhia a, amahmah kigui-awk hi.
Siampi liante in ngun sumtangte tawm uh a, “Hih sum pen sisan man ahih manin biakinn sumpi laka koih ding phaltheih thu hilo,” ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amau teng kikum uh a, tua sum tawh khualmite' sihvuina mun dingin beelseekpa' lo lei uh hi.
Tua hangin tua lo pen tuni dongin Sisan Leitang kici hi.
Hih pen kamsang Jeremiah' gensa thu a tangtunna hi a, a genna hih bang ahi hi: “Tua ciangin amaute in ama' manzah dinga Israel mi kimkhatte' sehsa, ama' manzah ahi tua ngun sumtang sawmthum la uh a,
Topa in kei' tunga hong vaikhak mah bangin beelseekpa' lo lei nadingin pia uh hi.”
Tu-in gam-uk mangpa' mai-ah Jesu ding a, mangpa in, “Nang Jew Kumpi na hi hiam?” ci-in dong hi. Jesu in, “Ahi bangin na gen hi,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin siampi liante leh Jew makaite in a mawhmat uh ciangin kam khat beek dawng lo hi.
Tua ciangin Pilate in, “Nang' langkhat ah amaute in thu bangzah tak gen uh cih za lo na hi hiam?” ci hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in dawng lo, thu khat nangawn dawngkik lo ahih manin gam-uk mangpa in lamdang sa mahmah hi.
Pawi hun simin gam-uk mangpa in mihonpi' deih, thongkia mi khatpeuh, amau' kiangah khahkhia thei zel hi.
Tua hunin migilo-a minthang Barabbas a kici thongkia khat om hi.
Mihonpi hong kikhop uh ciangin Pilate in mihonpi' kiangah, “Note' ading kua kong khahsak ding ut na hi uh hiam? Barabbas hiam, Khris a kici Jesu hiam?” ci hi.
A hang pen hazatna tawh Jesu lehhek uh ahihlam thei ahih man hi.
Tua banah thukhenna tokhom tungah a tut laitak a zi in, “Tua midikpa bangmah cihkha kei in. Tuni ama' hangin ka mang sungah gimna nakpi ka thuak khin hi,” ci-in thu zasak hi.
Tu-in siampi liante leh Jew makaite in Barabbas a ngenkhia dingin leh Jesu a thatsak dingin mihonpi zol uh hi.
Gam-uk mangpa in mihonpi dong leuleu a, “Note' adingin hih mi nihte lakpan kuazaw kong khahsak ding ut na hi uh hiam?” a cih ciangin mihonpi in, “Barabbas,” ci uh hi.
Pilate in, “Tua ahihleh Khris a kici Jesu bangci hih ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin a vekun, “Amah khailup thuak ta hen!” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pilate in, “Bang hang hiam? Hih mipa in bang thusia bawl ahi hiam?” ci hi. Ahih hangin-in amaute uang semsem uh a, “Amah khailup thuak ta hen!” ci-in awng uh hi.

Pilate in ama' vaihawmna tangtung lo ahihlam leh mihonpi zong so ding kipan ahihlam a muh ciangin tui la-in mihonpi' mai-ah a khut sil a, “Hih mipa' sisan thu ah mawh ka baang kei hi. Hih thu note' vai hita hen,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, “Ama' sisan kote' tung leh ka suan ka khakte uh tungah hong tu ta hen!” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pilate in Barabbas khah a, Jesu ahihleh a satnimsak khit ciangin khailup dingin ap hi.
Tua ciangin gam-uk mangpa' galkapte in mang innpi ah Jesu paipih uh a, ama' kiim ah galkap thuangpi bup kaikhawm uh hi.
Galkapte in Jesu a puansilh suahkhiatsak uh a, puantual a san khat silhsak uh hi.
Kumpi lukhu danin linggui khat vialin a lu tungah koih uh a, pumpeng khat a khut taklam ah tawisak uh hi. Tua ciangin a mai-ah khukdin uh a, “Jew Kumpipa, na cidam ta hen!” ci-in zahpih uh hi.
Tua ciangin cilphih uh a, pumpeng la-in a lu sat uh hi.
Tua bangin a zahpih khit uh ciangin a puantual silhsak uh suahkhiatsakin ama' puante mah silhsakkik uh a, singlamteh tungah khailup dingin paikhiatpih uh hi.
A pai laitakun a min Simon a kici Cyrene khuami khat tawh kituak uh a, zawhthawh thu tawh Jesu' singlamteh puasak uh hi.
Golgotha (a khiatna: Misi Luguh Mun) a kici mun a tun uh ciangin
Jesu' dawn dingin zakha kisawh lengtui pia uh a, ahih hangin Jesu in a ciap khit ciangin dawn nuamlo hi.
Singlamteh tungah a khai khit uh ciangin a puansilhte suangtang aisanna tawh hawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin tusuk uh a, Jesu encik uh hi.
Tua ciangin ama' lutang tungsan ah, “Hih pen Jew Mite' Kumpi, Jesu ahi hi,” ci-in mawhmatna suang uh hi.
Tua banah guta buluh mi nih zong a taklam ah khat, a veilam ah khat, Jesu tawh khaikhawm uh hi.
Tua gei-a lampai mite in a Jesu zahko-in lu peisan uh a,
“Biakinnpi phelkhia-in ni thum sungin a lamkik ding mipa aw, nangmahmah kihonkhia in! Pasian' Tapa na hih takpi leh singlamteh tungpan hong kumsuk in,” ci uh hi.
Laisiamte leh Jew makaite tawh kithuahin siampi liante in zong zahko uh a,
“Hih mipa in midangte honkhia napi amahmah kihonkhia theilo hi. Amah Israel Kumpi ahihleh tu-in singlamteh tungpan hong kumsuk ta hen! Tua hileh amah i um ding hi.
Amah in Pasian muang hi. ‘Pasian' Tapa ka hi,’ ci ahih manin Pasian a thukim leh tu-in amah honkhia ta hen,” ci uh hi.
Amah tawh kikhaikhawm guta buluhte in zong tua dan mahin zahpih kobawl uh hi.
Sunkim nai sawmlenih pan kipanin sunnung nai thum ciangdong gam bup khimzing hi.
Sunnung nai thum pawl ciangin Jesu awging lianpi tawh kiko a, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” ci hi. A khiatna pen, “Ka Pasian, Ka Pasian, bang hangin kei hong nusia na hi hiam?” cihna hi.
A gei-a om mi kimkhat in a zak uh ciangin, “Hih mipa in Elijah sam hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute khat va tai-in tuihup khat la a, lengtui thuk sungah tuihup a diah khit ciangin pumpeng dawn ah khihin Jesu' tawp theih dingin tahto hi.
Kimkhat leuleu in, “Khawl dih un; amah a honkhia dingin Elijah hong pai hiam en phot ni,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu awging lianpi tawh kiko leuleu-in a hu tawpna sangkhia hi.
Tua ciangin, en un, biakinnpi sunga inndei puanpi a tungkhung pan a nuaitaw dong kikekin phel nih kisuah hi. Leitang kilokin suangpite kitam hi.
Hankhukte zong kihong a, a ihmu khinsa mi siangtho tampite' misiluangte zong kithokiksak hi.
Jesu a thawhkik khit ciangin tua mi siangthote hankhuk sungpan paikhia uh a, khuapi siangtho sungah lutin mi tampite' tungah kilang uh hi.
Jesu a cing galkap za-uk bupa leh amah tawh a om galkapte in zinling leh a thupiang a muh uh ciangin lau mahmah uh a, “Hih mipa Pasian' Tapa hi taktak hi!” ci uh hi.
Galilee pan Jesu zui-in amah a don numei tampite zong tua mun ah om uh a, a gamla pan gal-et uh hi.
Tuate lakah Magdala khuami Mary, James leh Joseph ii nu Mary leh Zebedee' tate ii nu, cihte kihel uh hi.
Nitak ciangin Jesu' nungzui khat mah ahi, Arimathea khua pan Joseph minnei mihau khat hong pai hi.
Pilate' kiangah amah pai-in Jesu' luang ngen a, Pilate in zong piak dingin thupia hi.
Tua ciangin Joseph in Jesu' luang la-in puannel dialpi siang khat tawh tun a,
ama' adinga a bawlsa, suangpi a kikhuak hankhuk thak sungah sial hi. Tua panin suangtumpi khat khukin hankhuk kongvang a huk khit ciangin paikhia hi.
Magdala khuami Mary leh Mary a dang khat zong hankhuk maingatin tu uh hi.
(Kiginni khit) a zingciangin siampi liante leh Pharisee-te Pilate' kiangah kikaikhawm uh a,
“Topa aw, hua mikhempa a nuntak lai-in, ‘Ni thum khit ciang ka thokik ding hi,’ a cih ka phawk uh hi.

Tua ahih manin a ni thum ni dong hankhuk galbit theih nading thupia in. Tua hikeileh ama' nungzuite hong pai-in amah gukhia-in Jew mite' kiangah, ‘Misite' lakpan Jesu thokik khin hi,’ ci ding uh a, tua zuau thu a nihna pen a masa sangin siahuaizaw ding hi,” ci uh hi.
Pilate in, “Galkapte kimkhat hancing dingin na zang un. Pai unla galbit theithei dingin bawl un,” ci hi.
Amaute zong pai-in hankhuk galbit theih nadingin hancing galkapte tawh suangtumpi tungah ciaptehna gip belh uh hi.
